name: Shadewell: a ghost released at Shadewell Spring reaches the Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies in zone 10305 (Shadewell), area 10196 (Shadewell Spring), releases at Shadewell Spring 6074 (-8594.75,-615.457,144.698), the graveyard linked to that zone, instead of the default Westfall graveyard, and its Spirit Healer 6491 stands about 9 yards from it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Shadewell Spring graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
